dedupe_keys.name: ancom netograf crowdsourced internet speed measurements and annual internet access quality reports romania

description: Netograf is the platform of Romania's communications regulator ANCOM for users to measure the quality of their internet access, and ANCOM publishes an annual report on the quality of internet access services based on it. The report for 2024, released on 24 July 2025, draws on about 105,000 valid measurements made by users through Netograf (68 per cent on fixed and 32 per cent on mobile connections), with detailed analysis for the four largest fixed providers by number of connections and the four mobile providers. It gives national and per-provider statistics on technical quality parameters (download and upload speed, delay and delay variation), and on administrative parameters from providers' half-yearly reports (time to supply service, time to repair faults, time to resolve complaints and complaint frequency), and for the first time an analysis of quality of experience for VoIP, web browsing, video streaming, online gaming, social media and file transfer. National average download speed was 446 Mbit/s on fixed cable connections and 58 Mbit/s on mobile. Coverage: Romania. Format and access: web measurement platform and PDF reports, free. Caveats: crowdsourced measurements depend on who tests; the report PDF and any open data release were not read; ANCOM's statistics and map portals did not answer. Simulation uses: measured speeds and latency by provider as baselines for service degradation scenarios. Related records: Breitbandmessung, RTR-NetTest and ČTÚ NetTest are comparable regulator measurement tools.
